arguments.sql:
SELECT f."High Grade", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.GSserved) AS served_spans,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.State) AS states, COUNT(*) AS sites, COUNT(t.cds) AS sat_rows
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE TRIM(s.School) <> '' AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
GROUP BY f."High Grade"

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."High Grade" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8')
  AND COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0
LIMIT 1
